 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice S. B. Pd. Singh

Oral Order
5 10-02-2025

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2.

The instant application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the petitioner apprehending his arrest in a case instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 323, 341, 498(A)/34, 494 of Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. As per the allegation, complainant was married to petitioner in the year 2013.

It is further alleged that petitioner and other accused persons started torturing the complainant for dowry of Rs.
5,00,000/- (five lakh rupees) Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.26425 of 2024(5) dt.10-02-2025 and a car.
It is further alleged that in the year 2014, she was blessed with twin children out of her wedlock with the petitioner but neither the petitioner nor his family member cared about her.
They continued their demand of dowry.
4. From perusal of the mediator's report (Flag 'A'), it appears that the dispute between the parties could bot be settled through the process of mediation.
Hence, mediation failed.
5. In pursuance to the direction of this Court, both parties appeared with their respective counsel.
Petitioner (husband) submits before the court that he is ready to keep his wife (O.P. No. 2) with full honour and dignity.
Complainant also wants to lead the conjugal life with the petitioner.

sentences.text: 6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case as stated above, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on provisional bail till next date of hearing.
The petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within a period of four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender in Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.26425 of 2024(5) dt.10-02-2025 connection with Complaint Case No. 376(C) of 2016

, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Bhagalpur, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
7.
Both the parties are directed to appear in person on the next fixed date.

8. List this matter on 15.04.2025 at 2:15 P.M. for chambers proceedings.
